title: Affidavit of [NAME] in Support of Plaintiff's Motion to [RELIEF]

body.text: [Use for an ordinary affidavit when a sworn statement is required or chosen. Confirm the applicable oath, signature, and notarial requirements. A generic affidavit does not satisfy the specialized procedures for a deposition, oath of office, recordable instrument, or will. For eligible unsworn statements, consider 05-declaration under Wis. Stat. § 887.015. Replace the venue below with the actual place of the notarial act and remove this note before execution.]
[NAME], being first duly sworn on oath, deposes and states:
1. I am [NAME AND RELATION TO THE MATTER] and make this affidavit on personal knowledge.
2. [One evidentiary fact. No argument, no legal conclusions.]
3. Attached as Exhibit A is a true and correct copy of [document].
[AFFIANT'S PRINTED NAME AND ANY REQUIRED CONTACT INFORMATION]
Subscribed and sworn to before me this ____ day of __________, [YEAR].
Notary Public, State of [NOTARY'S COMMISSIONING STATE]
